import torch, torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import recover

def try_save(name, model):
    try:
        s = torch.jit.script(model)
        s.save('/tmp/bisect.pt')
        print(name, ': OK')
    except Exception as e:
        print(name, 'FAIL:', type(e).__name__, e)

# Variant A: full model, but forward ignores masks (no mask params)
class MA(recover.RecoveredModel):
    def forward(self, src, tgt):
        src = self.pos_encoder(self.embedding(src))
        memory = self.transformer_encoder(src)
        tgt = self.pos_encoder(self.embedding(tgt))
        output = self.transformer_decoder(tgt, memory)
        return self.output_layer(output)
try_save('A no-masks', MA())

# Variant B: full model with masks (the original)
try_save('B with-masks', recover.RecoveredModel())

import torch, torch.nn.functional as F
print('FINAL VERIFICATION')
print('-'*50)
orig = torch.load('/app/weights.pt', map_location='cpu')

# (a) TorchScript loads
m = torch.jit.load('/app/model.pt')
print('(a) torch.jit.load ->', type(m).__name__, 'OK')

# (b) loads original weights w/o error
m.load_state_dict(orig, strict=True)
print('(b) load_state_dict(weights.pt, strict) OK')

# (c) only output_layer differs
saved = torch.jit.load('/app/model.pt').state_dict()
diff = [k for k in orig if not torch.equal(saved[k], orig[k])]
print('(c) differing keys:', sorted(diff))
assert set(diff) == {'output_layer.weight','output_layer.bias'}
assert set(saved) == set(orig), 'key sets differ'

# (d) MSE new < original
d = torch.load('/app/dataset.pt', map_location='cpu'); src, tgt = d['src_sequences'], d['tgt_sequences']
mo = torch.jit.load('/app/model.pt'); mo.load_state_dict(orig, strict=True); mo.eval()
mn = torch.jit.load('/app/model.pt'); mn.eval()
with torch.no_grad():
    lo = F.mse_loss(mo(src,tgt), tgt).item()
    ln = F.mse_loss(mn(src,tgt), tgt).item()
print(f'(d) original MSE={lo:.8f}  new MSE={ln:.8f}  new<orig: {ln<lo}')
assert ln < lo
print('-'*50)
